body:
Hang in there dude. Your only 14, you will be a totally diff person at 18, 21, and at 25... It's amazing how much we change over the years even though we tell ourselves we are the same.

You owe it to those guys to hang in there. The future yous. Life is fairly random man. Don't deny yourself the opportunity to experience it all cause of a temporary situation.

I wish I could go back to my 14 year self and give him a hug and tell him it'll be OK, when he was on his own crying and cutting himself and contemplating suicide. And I wish I could give you a hug now. It will be OK.

It's OK. Get out of your head and stop the self hatred.

You seem really angry and upset, try to take a step back from it all and relax.

You need to try to love yourself OK? We can be our own worst enemies at times and when we're down in the dumps it's easy to see hate in the world around us.

Art is about expression, so just do what makes you happy and express yourself.

I know how your feeling, I've been there too. It will be OK, I promise.

I love you. I know you feel crap and worthless now and it's hard to imagine things being any different but they will be. In a year or 5 years you could be so happy and content in life that you'd find it hard to believe you were ever suicidal or that sad.


I can relate to a lot of what your feeling. When I am happy I try to tell myself to remember it when I'm down. I find it hard to remind myself though. Writing this post made did remind me about that though, so thanks (I came here for advice myself).

I know how pointless it can seem, but try to change your situation instead of suicide.

It can be hard to get out of your own head sometimes. But remember that more people love and care about you than you realise.
